alert: Loom role-runner item tick after the cutover

A.name: A
A.query:
WITH
  toInt64({{.end_timestamp_nano}}) AS end_ns,
  ticks AS (
    SELECT if(resources_string['host.name'] != '', resources_string['host.name'], resources_string['host.id']) AS host,
           attributes_string['loom.role'] AS role,
           count() AS n
    FROM signoz_logs.distributed_logs_v2
    WHERE timestamp >= {{.start_timestamp_nano}}
      AND timestamp < {{.end_timestamp_nano}}
      AND attributes_string['loom.kind'] = 'role_tick.outcome'
      AND attributes_string['loom.role'] IN ('curator', 'judge', 'doctor')
      AND attributes_string['loom.role_tick.source'] != 'step'
    GROUP BY host, role
  )
SELECT toDateTime(intDiv(end_ns, 1000000000)) AS ts,
       host,
       role,
       toFloat64(n) AS value
FROM ticks
WHERE host != ''
ORDER BY host, role

annotations.summary: Loom role-runner item tick after the cutover
annotations.description: Host {{$labels.host}} ran {{$value}} {{$labels.role}} role_tick.outcome records in 30 min that are not step-engine steps (loom.role_tick.source != step, #11988). Since #11909 Curator, Judge and Doctor run only as work-finder steps; a role-runner tick of one means the host still runs a pre-cutover daemon, or an interval loop survived, and it double-acts with the steps on the same items. Check the host's loom-daemon version and its role_runner log. Issue rjwalters/loom#11909.
